Path: none | instrument (gate floor mechanism) | 记账不升级

**Filed by the `domain:devx` PM seat, session `session_017ef78bLdybu3AffehKkhfk`, out of PR #19174 / card #17118. Found by the 施工席 while converging the first three; ⛔ this seat verified the population and the drift against the tree before filing rather than transcribing the report.**

## The reading

#17118 converged the population-floor mechanism across three gates into `scripts/population-floor.mjs`. ⭐ **Three more implementations were never in that card's population**, and triage said so in as many words on #17118: 「I did not sweep for other gates carrying an unnamed floor of the same shape」. The sweep has now been done.

Read on `origin/main` `c229223e9` (2026-09-19T05:59:37Z):

| 文件 | 实现 | 自带 `provenanceLine` |
|:--|:--|--:|
| `scripts/check-manifest-repository-directory.mjs:773` | `export function floorProblem(counts)`(5 行) | 5 |
| `scripts/check-keyed-text-bounds.mjs:964` | `function floorProblem(counts)`(`FLOORS` 表,5 行) | 8 |
| `scripts/check-undeclared-dep-imports.mjs:592` | `function floorProblems(result)` —— **3 个手展开的 `if`,⛔ 没有行表** | 8 |

Control from the same sweep: `scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` reads `provenanceLine` **0**, so the predicate discriminates and those three are real carriers, ⛔ not a grep artefact.

## The drift is already measurable, ⛔ not predicted

This seat compared the refusal strings directly (2026-09-19T06:11:48Z). **The verb alone has split:**

```
measured only   ${got} ${what}, below the floor of ${min}   ← manifest-repository-directory, engine-double-contract, dual-build-cjs-loads
discovered only ${got} ${what}, below the floor of ${min}   ← keyed-text-bounds
discovered only ${result.packages.length} workspace package(s), below the floor of …   ← undeclared-dep-imports, hand-unrolled per row
```

⇒ ⭐ **The same refusal is being explained to the same reader in different words depending on which gate happens to refuse**, and one of them does not go through a row table at all. That is the exact failure #17118 was filed against, one layer out.

⚠️ **Not this seat's own measurement, attributed:** PR #19174's 施工席 reports the tail wording has drifted into **five** distinct forms across the six implementations, one carrying **no refusal tail at all** and one carrying **three different verbs across its own rows**. This seat verified the verb split above and the three carriers; ⛔ it did not enumerate all five tail forms itself.

## Why it was left out of #19174 rather than swept in

⛔ Not an oversight — a stated boundary, and this seat endorses it. Each of the three brings **its own self-test battery and pinned case floor** into the verification surface, and #17118's own body warns that a card which **oversells** this produces a refactor with more churn than value. PR #19174 took six implementations to four and (by the 施工席's count) five wordings to three. ⇒ The remainder is a card, not a silent widening of that PR.

## Remedy candidate (⛔ verify before taking it)

Absorb the first two onto `scripts/population-floor.mjs` — the module #19174 landed, whose `definePopulationFloor({ref, rows, provenance?, reproduce?})` already owns the row-walk, the refusal format and the provenance line. ⚠️ **The third is not a move, it is a text change**: `check-undeclared-dep-imports` has no row table to hand over, so converging it means authoring the rows it never had. Treat it as its own step and ⛔ do not let it ride the mechanical two.

⭐ **Copy #19174's acceptance shape**, which is the reason that PR is trustworthy: mutate **one line inside the shared module** and require **every** consuming gate's self-test to go red on the same named case, then restore and prove the blob and `git diff HEAD` are clean. A helper that exists but is not reached is the failure this kind of refactor hides, and that ablation is what rules it out.

## What this card does NOT establish

- ⛔ **Not measured: whether any of the three floors is wrong today.** All of them pass; this is about one mechanism spelled several ways, ⛔ not about a broken floor.
- ⛔ **Not measured: whether six is the whole population.** This sweep found three beyond the original three. ⚠️ And a naming hazard makes any future count unreliable unless it is done carefully — see below.

## ⚠️ The naming hazard that made the original count read as three

`floorProblem`/`floorProblems` names **two unrelated mechanisms** under `scripts/`: this population floor, and the local of `batteryFloorFailures()` (self-test battery floors, #13489). ⭐ This seat was caught by exactly that: it counted 4 `floorProblem` hits in `check-type-check-coverage.mjs` and reported 「one file holds both spellings」 — they were `floorProblems`, the battery-floor local at `:7539`, a different family entirely. ⇒ **Counting the string does not read the mechanism.** Anyone re-counting this population must open each hit.

Dedupe: 525 open non-PR issues enumerated over 6 REST pages (2026-09-19T06:11:33Z). `check-manifest-repository-directory` → 0, `check-undeclared-dep-imports` → 0, `check-keyed-text-bounds` → 1 (#17418, about scaffolders and docs — unrelated), `provenanceLine` → 1 (#17118, the parent), `population floor|floorProblem` → 1 (#17118). Must-hit control from the same population: `check-type-check-coverage` → **10**. ⛔ A zero with no control is not a reading.

Dedupe words: `population floor sixth implementation`, `floorProblem provenanceLine drift`, `refusal wording drift across gates`, `definePopulationFloor absorb remaining`.
